usedFor: Shopify raises order events, and Docamatic builds documents through “Convert URL or HTML to Image” and “Password Protect PDF”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Password Protect PDF” in Docamatic
bestTemplate.why: A paid order can lock its PDF before the document is shared.

watchOut: “Password Protect PDF” in Docamatic protects an existing PDF, so the step needs that document supplied.
